approved_by: PI, relayed by the repository owner
what_changed: The RRCS section heading 'Complete RRCS results' became 'RRCS results', and reports whose table is capped at 1,000 rows gained one line directly below that heading: 'Showing 1,000 of N contact pairs.'
why: _get_complete_rrcs() caps the table at 1,000 rows, so 'Complete' overstated it for 7 of the 283 receptors.
scope: The sec-rrcs section header only. Nothing else in any report section is covered by this approval. The pre-V3 baseline in freeze_manifest.json is unchanged and remains authoritative: the freeze test reverses the two edits below and then compares against that baseline, so any other difference still fails.
ordering: delta_df.nlargest(1000, 'abs_delta'): the 1,000 contact pairs with the largest |ΔRRCS|, descending. Ties broken by pandas' nlargest, which keeps first occurrence in row order.
